Their money is as good as anyone else's. Please sit.|Binneed speaks about his previous employers|{{StoryCite|story=The Ride|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)}}}} '''Mosep Binneed''' was a [[Nimbanel]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as an [[accountant]] for various criminals throughout his life. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], he spent time in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]]. In [[4 ABY]], Binneed was in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] arrived in disguise as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] as her prisoner. Their arrival was part of a [[Rescue of Han Solo|plan]] to rescue the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] from Jabba's clutches, and soon after Organa's arrival Jabba and many of his courtiers were [[Death|killed]] over the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. By [[34 ABY]], the Nimbanel accountant was working on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] for a new crime lord, "Big" [[Sturg Ganna]]. On Ganna's orders he provided the [[Heptooinian]] [[Gambling|gambler]] [[Kaljach Sonmi]] with eight hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to use at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]]. When Sonmi ran out of funds, Binneed had [[Orisha Okum]]—another gambler in Ganna's employ—tell the Heptooinian that he had to pay Ganna back by sunrise the next day. Sonmi made efforts to earn back what he owed, but had failed to gather enough by three [[Standard hour|hours]] to dawn. Binneed had Okum bring Sonmi to him in a private viewing box at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Bight racetrack]] and then ordered one of his [[Wookiee]] bodyguards to drop the gambler over the box's edge to his [[death]]. Before the Wookiee could complete the order though, [[Time for Flatcakes]]—a [[fathier]] that Sonmi had bought—won a race. Seeing this, Binneed spared the Heptooninian who then managed to earn back the full amount he owed in the next three hours and repay Binneed and Ganna. ==Biography== ===Time on Tatooine=== [[File:Binneed_and_speeder.png|thumb|left|200px|Binneed spent time in Mos Eisley.]] Mosep Binneed was a [[Nimbanel]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Nimban]] who [[Jabba's criminal empire|worked]] as an [[accountant]] and henchman for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] at he beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1}} he spent [[time]] in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley]] and was in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], where he witnessed the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] cut down the criminals [[Ponda Baba]] and [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] during a confrontation. He then sat at a table with the [[Snivvian]] [[Zutton]] when the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] shot the [[bounty hunter]] [[Greedo]] in one of the [[cantina]]'s other booths. [[File:Mosep_Binneed_ME_streets.jpg|200px|thumb|Mosep in Mos Eisley]] Binneed then left the establishment and stood by an [[X-34 landspeeder]] as its owner [[Luke Skywalker]] sold it. A short time later he walked behind Skywalker and Kenobi as they approached [[Docking Bay 94]]. [[4 ABY|Four years later]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' states that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] occur in [[4 ABY]]. Binneed was in one of the booths of the [[throne]] room of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine during a performance of the [[Music|song]] "[[Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band]] for the Hutt and his court. When the song finished, Jabba demanded it be repeated, but the Hutt interrupted the second performance by dropping the [[Slavery|enslaved]] [[Twi'lek]] dancer [[Oola]] into the pit below his throne room after she refused the Hutt's advances. Binneed stood within the booth and craned to see while the court rushed forward to watch as Oola was eaten by Jabba's pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]].{{Film|VI}} ===Bomb scare=== When the spectacle was over, the courts attention was drawn by [[blaster]] fire to the throne room's entry way, where [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] arrived in disguise as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]]. Organa and her [[Wookiee]] ally [[Chewbacca]] were there to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] Solo from Jabba's clutches, and as part of their plan she delivered Chewbacca in chains to the Hutt and asked for the [[bounty]] the crime lord had placed on the Wookiee's head. During negotiations over the size of the bounty for Chewbacca, Organa activated a [[thermal detonator]] as a threat, causing Binneed and the other occupants of the throne room to duck for cover and cower in fear. Once Jabba settle on a compromise, she deactivated the detonator and the court relaxed while Chewbacca was taken away. ===Rescue of Han Solo=== [[File:Luke-DL18.jpg|thumb|right|Luke Skywalker negotiated for the release of his friends while Binneed watched.|250px]] Later that night, Organa was captured after freeing Solo and the court celebrated late into the night. The following morning, Binneed was resting in one of the throne room's booths when Skywalker arrived to try and negotiate for the release of Solo, Organa and Chewbacca. Skywalker's negotiations were unsuccessful, and the Hutt dropped him into a pit containing the [[rancor]] [[Pateesa]]; however, he was able to [[Death|kill]] the beast. Jabba then ordered that Skywalker and the other [[prisoner]]s be taken to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] to be executed. Above the pit, Skywalker and the others freed themselves and managed to kill Jabba and many of his courtiers. ===A new boss=== {{Quote|And you know that fur-faced fellow—the old gray-haired guy, who floated you the loans you've been playing on for the last eighteen months?"''
''"Yes?"''
''"Did you know that he's the accountant for Big Sturg Ganna?"''
"''No.|Okum and Sonmi|}} [[File:SturgGanna.png|thumb|left|Sturg Ganna employed Binneed as an accountant.|250px]] By the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], Binneed was working on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] as an accountant for the crime lord [[Sturg Ganna]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]]. The Nimbanel lent eight hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to the [[Heptooinian]] [[gambler]] [[Kaljach Sonmi]] because he and Ganna believed that Sonmi's [[starship]] might be worth something; however, when the Heptooinian later became a proposition player at [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] they decided he could be useful as an insider. They later had professional [[Gambling|gambler]] [[Orisha Okum]] take a look at a strategy Sonmi was developing for the game [[zinbiddle]] to see if it had potential, and when she said it might this bought the debtor more time. After eighteen [[Standard month|months]], Sonmi lost the last of his credits on zinbiddle, so Binneed sent Okum to inform him that Ganna wanted his money back. The gambler had until dawn the next [[Standard day|day]] to repay Binneed the full amount that had been given to him, or he would face the consequences. The Heptooinian, who had thought that Binneed was a wealthy eccentric who was gifting him credits, panicked and attempted to earn back his [[Currency|money]] through more gambling, teaming up with the three [[Suerton]]s known as the [[Lucky Three]]. ===Reclaiming a debt=== {{Quote|Close is not enough. I want every coin—and by sunrise, as agreed. You have three hours, by my calculations. If you don't think that's possible, of course, I would be happy to take what you have."''
''"But you'd still kill me."''
''"My accounts always balance, Master Sonmi. Farewell.|Binneed and Sonmi|}} Sonmi did well with the time he had, but at three [[Standard hour|hours]] to dawn he lost it all when two of the Suertons misunderstood his wishes and spent all his earnings on purchasing the [[fathier]] [[Time for Flatcakes]]. Binneed had Okum bring the Heptooinian to him while he waited with two [[Wookiee]] [[bodyguard]]s in a private box at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Bight racetrack]]. He then discussed Sonmi's debt with him before ordering one of the Wookiees to throw the gambler to his death over the side of the box. The debtor was only spared at the final moment when it was announced that Time for Flatcakes had won the race it was participating in. Surprised, Binneed had the Wookiee spare Sonmi and warned the Heptooinian that he still only had three hours to make up the rest of what he owed. Somni left the box and was able to make the money he needed by beating Okum in a game of [[pazaak]], allowing him to pay off his debt to Binneed and Ganna and survive to see another day. Binneed was mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' at some point no earlier than 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}} ==Personality and traits== Binneed was a small creature, but like most Nimbanel he had big ideas about becoming a bureaucrat. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Mosep_Binneed_canon.png|thumb|250px|right|Mosep Binneed first appeared in ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope''.]] Mosep Binneed first appeared in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and later in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. [[Annette Jones]] portrayed the character in ''A New Hope'',{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Black & White: A New Hope|cardname=Annette Jones as Mosep Binneed}} but in ''Return of the Jedi'' he was portrayed by [[Richard Bonehill]].{{WebCite|url=http://www.convention-guests.com/html/richard_bonehill.html|text=Richard Bonehill|work=Convention-Guests|archivedate=20100411072040}} See also [http://www.convention-guests.com/assets/images/Richard-Bonehill-ESB.jpg image]. The character's name was first used in [[canon]] in the [[2017]] short story "[[The Ride]]" by [[John Jackson Miller]]. Bineed's listing in ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'', a canon reference book published in [[2018]], tells that he perished during the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which was in [[4 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' However, he appears alive in the "[[The Ride]]," a short story set in [[34 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]]. [https://www.starwars.com/news/4-reasons-canto-bight-is-an-essential-read As] "The Ride" takes place [[Standard day|days]] before ''The Last Jedi'', it can be assumed to take place in the same year. The discrepancy has not yet been resolved by [[Lucasfilm Story Group]]. The name Mosep Binneed originated in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], with the character's forename first being used by the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] in [[1996]] to identify a separate [[Tawss Khaa/Legends|red-haired]] Nimbanel in ''A New Hope''.{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Mosep}} This Nimbanel was later re-identified as [[Tawss Khaa/Legends|Tawss Khaa]], with the white haired Nimbanel being changed to Mosep by a "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" article written by [[Leland Chee]] and published in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 130|130]].{{InsiderCite|130|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley}} The character having the surname Binneed originates in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' produced by [[Wizards of the Coast]].''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' ==Appearances== *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *{{Film|VI}} *[[Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo 1|''Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo'' 1]] {{Flash}} *{{StoryCite|story=The Ride|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)|audiobook=1}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|36|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' {{1stID|Mosep Binneed}} *''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' *''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes IV–VI, 1977–1983]]'' *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}} {{Po}} *[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Mosep Binneed |ka=მოსეპ ბინიდი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Binneed, Mosep}} [[Category:Accountants]] [[Category:Desilijic servants]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Nimbanels]]
